A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work and complete, readable 30-page documents, including Appendices A-M. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that substantive content is identical; only the first-page arXiv version/date metadata differs.

before.justification: v2 reports original detection and grounding experiments, ablations, generalization tests, and an Appendix A human study involving 15 participants and 100 sampled image-text pairs.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original experimental results and human study, including the main benchmark comparisons and appendix evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains identical AMD components, artifact pre-perception encoding, manipulation-oriented reasoning, token redundancy penalty, training losses, and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use identical dataset and task coverage, including MDSM, DGM4, COSMOS, MiRAGe, DiFF, DiffFace, and the appendix diffusion-based face and scene manipulation scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including ViLT, HAMMER, HAMMER++, FKA-Owl, Table 2's zero-shot models, and Table 9's fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL variants.

E3.justification: Training domains, evaluation procedures, metrics, preprocessing, budgets, model configurations, and human-study sample sizes are identical in the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: Component and modality ablations, token analyses, diffusion robustness tests, semantic-alignment experiments, and failure cases are retained unchanged in Table 4 and Appendices F, I-K, and M.

E5.justification: Both retain identical point estimates and descriptive statistics. Neither reports experimental seed/run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical and qualitative results are identical throughout. For example, Table 2 retains Guardian-trained AMD averages of 88.18 ACC, 60.25 mAP, and 61.02 mIoU; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions and reasoning, including Equations (1)-(10) and Section 4.4's token redundancy formulation, are identical. No assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about MDSM, AMD, semantically aligned deception, parameter efficiency, and generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including Appendix H's explanation of limited COSMOS performance and Appendix M's discussion of subtle facial manipulations and coherent fabricated text.

D1.justification: Prompts, implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters, data processing, and fine-tuning instructions are identical. Appendix E.1 retains the same statement that code will be released.

R1.justification: Section 2's research positioning and all 67 references are unchanged, including the discussions of DGM4, MMFakeBench, and FKA-Owl.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp changes from v2, 11 December 2025 to v3, 12 March 2026, with its version-specific link updated. Body wording, headings, and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-14, Tables 1-15, captions, placement, and page layout are unchanged. Rendered pages 2-30 match exactly; page 1 differs only in margin metadata.

improvement.justification: v3 updates only the arXiv version/date stamp and its corresponding link. Scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation are identical, establishing no meaningful gain or loss in overall paper quality.
